Subject is a compact open-front 8m by6m welcome dock office: chunky warm timber posts and crafted beams, small curved terracotta tile roof only on rear half, open counter, a separate angled tabletop island-map display in front, purple compass banner and brass lanterns, a pair of wood barrels, a few potted tropical leaves at edges, thin timber foundation.
